_doc: The desert's special sites (bead bzc.88, docs/art/classes/map-objects.md, docs/design/CONTENT_MAP_OBJECTS.md): the Pyramid (3x2 on 200 x 144), the Sphinx, the Sun Temple and the Sunken Tomb (2x2 on 128 x 128). generate-image-v2 at native display size like set map-objects; the imported sawmill is the style image for outline, pixel size and viewing angle only. Layers: style, light-south-west, class-map-object, subject. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

styleSawmill.usage: copy only the thick black outline, the pixel size, the flat shading with one shadow tone and the slightly-from-above front viewing angle; not the subject, not the colours and not the layout

recipes.subject: Subject: an ancient desert pyramid, a guarded treasure tomb: a big stepped pyramid of golden sandstone blocks #d6a862 with #9a6a3a shadows and a capstone of gold #e8b83a on its tip, a dark square doorway at the middle of its front bottom between two small seated stone guardian statues with jackal heads, a short flight of steps up to the door, a few gold coins on the steps. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, camel, palm tree, sand dune, ground, sky, sun
